conceptual_change: Incorporate the Chandelier Exit logic as an optional exit override function within the trade execution loop, triggered only when the 22-period ATR-based threshold is breached to minimize premature profit capture.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous rejection indicated the need for an explicit engine implementation of the Chandelier Exit. By refactoring the execution loop to include this logic as a modular override, we bridge the gap between architectural design and evaluable strategy logic.
